responsibility: Implements the GNU Modula-2 C bridge for POSIX select-style I/O waiting and timeval/fd_set manipulation. It wraps select, gettimeofday, raw single-byte read/write helpers, and allocation/accessor routines for timeval and fd_set objects, with conditional stub fallbacks when select support is unavailable, so Modula-2 libraries can construct polling sets and timeouts using opaque C-managed data.
